opening.argument: The speaker gives direct instructions to fund and register for Forsage BUSD slots, beginning with the requirement to "make sure it has a balance according to the need for a slot for a bus" and to allocate funds for gas fees. Registration is tied to recruitment through a referral link, which viewers are told to copy and paste into the browser. The associated page reinforces that structure with an "Automatic registration" flow requiring an invite ID. Meanwhile, the description promotes a "successful big team" moving into BUSD. These are not neutral references to the service: they combine paid tiered entry, referral-dependent registration, and team-based earnings promotion, making recruitment and participant earnings central to the call to action.
